name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's journey into motorsport started unconventionally, not on the track, but in his grandfather's autobody shop in Belgrade. There, amidst the smells of lacquer and the whine of sanders, he discovered his passion for making things look perfect. He honed his skills meticulously, learning the intricacies of paint application, color matching, and bodywork from the ground up. When a local racing team needed a paint specialist, Nikola jumped at the opportunity, bringing his obsession with detail to the high-stakes world of motorsport.

At Chip Ganassi Racing, Nikola is known for his adaptability and unwavering commitment to quality. He sees the paint job not just as aesthetics, but as an integral part of the car's performance, ensuring that every layer is applied flawlessly for optimal aerodynamics. His flexible approach allows him to seamlessly integrate with the engineering team, constantly seeking innovative solutions to improve the car's appearance and performance. His colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor under pressure and his willingness to go the extra mile to meet tight deadlines.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Nikola is of medium build with a focused look.

quirks: Always listens to traditional Serbian folk music while working.
Has a lucky paint brush that he uses for every final clear coat.
Meticulously cleans his workspace before leaving, regardless of how late it is.
